adjusted_volatile_messages: Prepare the requested reusable draft without executing any operation.
composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-transfer-00. It distinguishes missing from null via a presence guard before reading offset, accepts exact integers -4..5 inclusive (rejecting bool/float/other), and always returns {accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null}. The helper is invoked at module scope and its returned object is assigned to result. No imports, I/O, host calls, Tool dispatch, tests, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation occurred; target typed inputs needs selected-runner support.

payload.name: pc-transfer-00
payload.description: Raw offset may omit or contain any JSON value. Accept exact integers -4..5 inclusive (not bool/float). Always result={accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null}; invalid/missing return false/null without exceptions or coercion. Unapproved target typed-inputs draft only; selected-runner support, Q1 and human Q2 required.
